title: Effects of Cranberry-Containing Products in Women With Recurrent Urinary Tract Infections (UTIs)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the role of cranberry-containing products in preventing urinary tract infections (UTIs).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* At least two UTIs in the year prior to study entry
* Willing to use acceptable methods of contraception
* Willing to refrain from consuming other forms of cranberry supplementation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current UTI
* Allergy to cranberry-containing products
* Active urinary stone disease
* Insulin-dependent diabetes
* Immunosuppressive disease
* Current corticosteroid use
* Intermittent or indwelling catheterization
* Pregnancy
